summary: The projection's private-handle pattern is wider than the task-result sanitizer that feeds it (it also rejects 'subagent_*', and unanchored 'run_<8+>' in any text), so publishing raises instead of projecting.
failure_scenario: A completed task result such as 'Registered the subagent_stop hook.' passes _browser_safe_task_result unchanged (its _PRIVATE_RESULT_HANDLE has no subagent_ alternative), then BrowserEventProjection.publish('task_result', ...) raises ValueError('event data contains a private handle') inside the completion handler at host_launcher.py:1751, before the UpdateDirective is returned, so the finished result is neither shown nor voiced. Transcript/assistant text events containing e.g. 'run_all_tests' raise the same way, since they are not sanitized at all.
evidence: Static reading of projection.py:65/531, result_projection.py:20/108/175, host_launcher.py:1748-1758 and 2137-2181; executed the two regexes in isolation: 'subagent_stop hook' survives the sanitizer regex and matches the projection regex, 'run_all_tests' and 'test_run_configuration' match the projection regex, control text does not. Could not run the real publish path (uv sync needs network; livekit/aiohttp unavailable, stubbed import failed), so end-to-end raise and how callers absorb it are static-only. Existing test tests/client/test_projection.py:220 covers only 'subagent_public_opaque_handle' being rejected, enshrining the width.

summary: When refresh() fails and no delete is known pending, it announces 'Checking again.' but schedules nothing, so no recheck ever happens.
failure_scenario: delete() request outcome is unconfirmed -> catch sets recover and calls refresh(); the status request also fails (network blip) -> pending is false so schedule() is skipped; status says 'Checking again.' forever. If the server did start the delete, this page never polls it to complete/unknown. Likewise a failed initial refresh at connect leaves available=false, the delete button disabled and no retry until the next connect/reset.
evidence: Read refresh() catch branch (lines 107-113): schedule is gated on this.pending, which delete() never sets on the unconfirmed path (present() is only reached on success). Reachability via main.ts:3311 (connect) and 3553 callers confirmed; no test in web/tests/voice-delete-controls.dom.test.ts asserts the 'Checking again' text. Not executed (no JS test run).

summary: The Enter handler ignores modifier keys, so Shift+Enter submits instead of inserting a newline in the textarea.
failure_scenario: User presses Shift+Enter in the typed composer to start a new line -> keydown is preventDefault()ed and the form is submitted; multi-line typed input cannot be composed by keyboard.
evidence: Read typed-composer.ts and its tests: no test or doc states Shift+Enter should submit, and the control is a <textarea> (web/index.html:101). The server accepts text of 1-4096 chars (session.py:1434) with no newline restriction. Intent is not documented, so this is a usability gap rather than a contract violation.

summary: Prior claim web/src/main.ts:438 (approval with lost acknowledgment not consuming the sequence): disproved/accepted tradeoff. ApprovalDecisionController does not advance the sequence on a failed send, and Session.decide_approval (session.py:1542-1545) treats an exact repeat of (sequence, approvalId, decision) as an idempotent no-op, while a different decision at the same sequence is refused by the 'next expected' check (1547). A retried click therefore cannot double-apply or flip a decision; the sequence is only consumed after the authority call succeeds. Residual: if _approval succeeds but publish at 1553 raises, _last_approval_sequence is not advanced; ensure_capacity() runs first so this is not shown reachable.

Prior claim projection.py:65 (regex wider than the result sanitizer): reproduced as the first finding; the 'completed task result raises' consequence is limited to markers outside the sanitizer's set (subagent_*); deleg_/run_ in results are replaced by 'private reference' before publish.

Prior claim typed-composer.ts:8 (Shift+Enter submits): reproduced statically; reported as nit because intent is undocumented. Prior claim voice-delete-controls.ts:112: reproduced statically (second finding).

loopback.py and tailnet.py peer authorization: IPv4-mapped IPv6 peers are normalized before the loopback/Tailnet range tests, ports are range-checked, and wrong peer types fail closed. network_origin.canonical_remote_hostname rejects localhost, trailing-dot, non-ASCII, bracketed and loopback/unspecified forms; no bypass found by reading. Not executed against live sockets.

HTTP approval and events routes (client/http.py:601-680): exact field sets, exact types, content-type and body-size bounds checked before dispatch; legacy v1 events replace over-limit completed results with the notice using UTF-16 length. No defect found in the sampled routes; the rest of http.py, session.py (2085 lines), main.ts and controller.ts were only partially read, so absence of findings there is not a clean bill.

Limitation: dependencies could not be installed (uv sync offline failed on numpy; livekit/aiohttp absent), so pytest, ruff and mypy were not run and no production path was exercised end to end. The .venv attempt was removed; no tracked file was changed other than this artifact.
